'''Gopher''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Watchroo]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Always hiding in a sand burrow, Gopher waits for the right time to strike and only pops up now and then to take a look. It's a scary world out there..."

Gopher is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small rodent which is usually underground, with just its upper body poking out from its burrow. It has grey-brown fur, an off-white snout, and a pink nose and feet.

Gopher's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes the color of its fur to dark blue, and its snout and feet become light peach in color.

== Evolution Trial ==
Gopher's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Watchroo]] you need to complete the following task:

* Obtain another Gopher x1. They love to stick together.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Sandcastle dreams, candy-sized budget! After graduating, This Gopher had to dig its way up from a tiny hole."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Gopher loves digging pits and laughing at Tatari who fall in, but Zobos aren't safe from the tricks either."
